verdict.rationale: Godot exposes a substantial programmatic surface of its own. EditorInterface can save and reload scenes and inspect or edit resources. EditorScript and plugins add scripted in-editor functionality, the CLI supports working entirely from the command line, and headless mode enables scripted exports and editor automation. However, nothing documents that this surface matches everything the editor UI can do, and there is no network/REST API (OpenAPI probes 404) or official MCP for agents to drive the editor. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity guarantee, external network API or official MCP for remote/agent control, independent hands-on corroboration of full editor automation
